LESSON: WEATHER ENVIRONMENT

Grade: PP1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: NATURAL
Topic 3.3: Weather ENVIRONMENT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Weather ENVIRONMENT. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. observe weather conditions in ( 10 Lessons)
2. identify different weather observed conditions in the immediate environment
3. respond to weather conditions appropriately in the immediate environment
4. appreciate different weather conditions in the immediate environment to different activities as per weather conditions of the day eg playing with 138 kites, propellers during windy times and dressing Core-Competences to be developed:

1. observe weather conditions in ( 10 Lessons)
